thread:
maria.g: Heads up — I'll flip a graded override to move 10% of prod traffic from runtime-pool-b -> runtime-pool-a. Telemetry shows pool-b error-rate spiking to ~6% since 03:12 UTC. If errors > 4% for 2m or p50 latency > 250ms we kill to 0% :warning:

ajohnson: timeline? how are we rolling this? can we do a header-based shim so dedicated customers aren't impacted? :thinking:

sasha: header-shim is ideal but some legacy clients don't send the header. fallback needs to be weighted routing. keep it canary + short window.

maria.g: plan: 10% now -> monitor 3m -> rollback to 0% if errors>4% or p50 >250ms. kicking in 2m. Command I'll run: ```redwoodctl route set-weight --route=ingress/api-v2 --from=pool-b --to=pool-a --weight=0.1```

kevin: watching dashboards: https://console.redwood.local/dashboards/routing/ingress-api-v2 — I set a watch on errors and p50, alerts to #eng-oncall. Also bumping quota guard for dedicated clients so token drops don't cascade.

deploy-bot: rollout created by maria.g for ingress/api-v2 id=roll-72 state=STARTED at 2148887778

ops-bot: alert: error_rate_ingress_api_v2_pool_b crossed 4% (03:15 UTC) current=5.2% — https://console.redwood.local/alerts/12345

ajohnson: pulling logs from proxy-b: ```kubectl logs -n runtime proxy-b-yyy | grep '502' | tail -n 20``` seeing repeated backend timeouts (504) toward model-host-7

sasha: can we match only interactive/stream requests? set header X-Stream:true in match rule so batch jobs are unaffected.

maria.g: tried header-match, but a subset of clients doesn't send X-Stream. fallback is weighted route. proceeding with weight change now. If we need a hard kill: `redwoodctl route set-weight --route=ingress/api-v2 --from=pool-b --to=pool-a --weight=0.0`

kevin: rollback/playbook notes: snapshot dashboards + export traces. I'll attach a JSON snapshot to the incident. Postmortem owner? @sasha?

sasha: ack, I'll own postmortem. grabbing traces + eval diffs and recording failing request ids.

maria.g: toggle executed at 03:18 UTC — roll-72 at 10% now, monitoring.

deploy-bot: rollout update: roll-72 progress=10% health=DEGRADED at 2148887880

ops-bot: metric update: p50_latency_ingress_api_v2_pool_b = 310ms ; error_rate = 5.8% (03:19 UTC)

ajohnson: kill it now pls — we're seeing user impact/some 502s hitting frontends

maria.g: executing emergency kill at 03:20 UTC -> set weight 0% with reason 'emergency-kill-2148887777'
```bash
redwoodctl route set-weight --route=ingress/api-v2 --from=pool-b --to=pool-a --weight=0.0 --reason="emergency-kill-2148887777"
```

deploy-bot: rollout update: roll-72 state=ROLLED_BACK reason=emergency-kill-2148887777 at 2148888010

kevin: post-rollback checks: p50_pool_b = 78ms ; error_rate_pool_b = 0.3% ; dashboards look stable again :thumbsup: 

sasha: filing notes for postmortem: include model-host-7 logs + trace ids + failing request examples.

maria.g: follow-up items: create a canary config that prefers header matches + client-id allowlist to avoid broad weighted changes. Also add a "preflight runbook" button in Console that renders redwoodctl commands + opens the right dashboard panels. filing ticket RDW-4821.

ajohnson: +1 on preflight runbook and a request for per-route quota soft-limits to avoid cascading failures.

maria.g: RDW-4821 created, owner=ajohnson, ETA next sprint.

kevin: thanks all — capture any outstanding artifacts in the incident thread and we'll sync in triage. closing here :eyes:
